title: More Uses
description: Adds More Uses to item and also adds new structures
body:
A Mod that adds new structures and 2 new totems 
healing totem: makes you get insant health and regen
totem of village: make you get hearo of the village for 5 minutes
2 new structures
abandoned church pretty rare bit adds good loot
Bigger Dungeons also a bit rare underground and a bit hard challenge's and also good loot
